_comment: Documentation template for benchmarks/ai-native/v1 result.json files - not a JSON Schema validator, just an annotated example of the schemaVersion 1 shape. Copy this into runs/task-<NN>-<condition>/result.json and fill it in by hand after a trial.
notes: Free-text notes about anything unusual in this trial (agent got confused, needed a retry, etc). Optional token fields must be null (not fabricated) when not available from the model UI.
